You look across the empty space, breathe once, and trust the leap you have practiced all your life.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Agility
Target / range / shape
A visible unoccupied landing within 6 squares
Duration
Instant
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill

Choose a landing within the rolled distance. If none is safe, remain at the origin. This crosses gaps, not walls; it is not flight. Ordinary jumping remains available without this card.

Weak
Traverse up to 2 squares.
Standard
Traverse up to 4 squares.
Strong
Traverse up to 6 squares.
